中立摘要：維克倫·迪格瓦因謀殺亨利·諾瓦克，於2026年6月被判處終身監禁，最低服刑21年。上訴法院於2026年7月3日確認，迪格瓦正尋求對其定罪及刑期提出上訴。總檢察長艾莉·里夫斯曾將該刑期轉介，認為其「過於寬鬆」。兩項上訴均未設定日期。警察行為獨立辦公室正調查兩名警員，涉嫌嚴重不當行為，包括未能提供急救及決定給亨利·諾瓦克上手銬。調查亦審視種族或宗教是否影響了警員的決定。
summaries.en:
Title: Henry Nowak's killer appeals conviction and sentence
Neutral: Vickrum Digwa was sentenced to life imprisonment with a minimum of 21 years in June 2026 for the murder of Henry Nowak. The Court of Appeal confirmed on 3 July 2026 that Digwa is seeking to appeal his conviction and sentence. The Solicitor General, Ellie Reeves, had referred the sentence as "unduly lenient." No date has been set for either appeal. The Independent Office for Police Conduct is investigating two officers for potential gross misconduct, including failures to provide first aid and the decision to handcuff Henry Nowak. The investigation also examines whether race or religion influenced officers' decisions.

summaries.en:
Title: Yemen’s Houthis threaten Saudi Arabia after alleged airspace intrusion
Neutral:
On 3 July 2026, Yemen’s Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree stated in a video that the group would target Saudi airports and assets if Saudi Arabia violated its airspace or attacked it. The Houthi armed forces reported confronting Saudi warplanes that allegedly attempted to prevent an Iranian civilian aircraft from landing at Sanaa International Airport. Saree added that flights between Sanaa and Tehran would continue. Houthi media reported the aircraft landed and later returned to Tehran carrying a Houthi delegation for the funeral of former Iranian Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei.
